name: Scheller College of Business, Georgia Institute of Technology

class_size.note: From the 'Class of 2025 Profile' page of the employment report (page 3).

tuition_total.period: full program (2 x published annual figure)
tuition_total.cohort: current year as published (academic year not stated on page)
tuition_total.note: Annual tuition: in-state $30,548, out-of-state $44,956, out-of-country $46,260 (international: 2 x $46,260 = $92,520). 2-year total computed by us; the page does not state the academic year.

mandatory_fees_total.note: Mandatory Institute fees $1,516/year; additional $100 international student fee for international graduate students.

living_budget_total.note: Georgia Tech 2026-27 standard graduate cost of attendance (excluding tuition/fees), out-of-state, off campus. Same budget for all graduate programs (not MBA-specific). Out-of-country off campus: $25,256/yr; Georgia resident off campus: $24,996/yr.

scholarship.type: graduate assistantships (tuition reduction + monthly salary, value up to $93,000) and fellowships
scholarship.note: School: 'more than half of incoming Full-time MBA students receive funding'; no exact share or average award.

internship_monthly.note: '$9,293 per month, average base salary' (report p.9); no median read.

employment.notes: Report is an Issuu flipbook (no PDF); read as page images, copies saved as research/sources/amerique/georgia-tech-scheller-employment-2025-p*.jpg. CSEA tables: 72 graduates, 63 seeking; offers 63.5% by graduation + 19.0% by 3 months = 82.5%; acceptances 61.9% + 20.6% = 82.5%. 50 reported salary (96.2%). Median by work authorization: permanent $125,455, non-permanent $142,800. The summary page uses different shares (e.g. consulting 29.5%, technology 21.3%) than the CSEA tables; CSEA tables used here. Top 8 hiring companies listed without hire counts. Note: the career-development web page shows '$140,000 average starting salary / 85.9% employment rate, MBA Class of 2026' - newer headline, no full report found yet.

profile.note: Employment report p.3: 70 students, average GMAT 694 (middle 80% 640-722), GRE V 159 / Q 163. A newer class profile (Class of 2027) was not read in this pass.

notes: FT Global MBA 2026 rank not found. The report cites 'Top 5 MBA Career Services in the World - The Financial Times' (a sub-ranking, no year).
